:::{#def-noise}
#### Noise

The **noise** $\noise$ of a [new observation](#def-new-observation) $\paren{\newpredvar, \newoutvar}$ at the [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\newpredvar = \predvar$
is the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean)
of the new outcome $\newoutvar$ from the [mean function](#def-mean-function) value $\truemeanf{\predvar}$:

$$
\noise \eqdef \newoutvar - \truemeanf{\predvar}.
$$ {#eq-noise}

:::
